name: Hypnodose
look: a floating round adhesive patch with a slowly turning purple hypnotic spiral and a peeling edge tab
entry: Hypnodose latches onto stressed Pokémon, releasing a calm, rhythmic psychic pulse that eases agitation—though removing it causes sudden irritability.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Steady Release cures confusion and restores PP on its side every turn.
